scope: Updater source and its fixture tests only; no runtime data, worker, config, broker, or registered study source changes performed by this subtask.

behavior.dry_run_gap_behavior: detect only; no gap GET, receipt or CSV mutation

limitations: The broker also omitted the three known missing minutes, per parent bounded probe. This updater repair cannot recover candles the broker does not return.
This does not change the existing registered 335 contiguous common-minute requirement. It is a recovery/observability repair, not evidence that forecasts now work.
Gap scope is bounded recent small interior gaps only; it is not a full archive completeness audit.
Keep this updater the sole CSV writer. Optimistic file identity and tail-byte validation abort detected concurrent changes; other programs do not participate in a shared writer lock.
Two persisted attempts are a terminal automatic cap, including failed/interrupted reservations. No unbounded retry of broker omissions.
Atomic insertion streams the existing archive to a temporary file only when an actual missing row is recovered; old row bytes and schema are preserved.

A crash after CSV replacement but before the final publication receipt leaves the durable observation receipt and real row present; restart does not duplicate it, and no historical availability is invented.
